name: redaxo-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins for the REDAXO CMS and its addons

plugins.name: redaxo-core
plugins.description: Core REDAXO knowledge: architecture, modules, templates, rex_sql, extension points, addon development

plugins.name: redaxo-yform
plugins.description: YForm addon: tables, datasets, field validation, email templates, frontend forms

plugins.name: redaxo-yrewrite
plugins.description: YRewrite addon: domains, pretty URLs, redirects, multi-language SEO

plugins.name: redaxo-url
plugins.description: URL addon: dataset-driven pretty URLs, profiles, URL_PRE_SAVE hooks, frontend resolution, programmatic rebuilds

plugins.name: redaxo-structure
plugins.description: Structure addon: articles, categories, templates assignment, meta info, content editing

plugins.name: redaxo-ycom
plugins.description: YCom addon: frontend user authentication, login/registration/password forms, groups, media protection, OTP/2FA, tokens, SAML/OAuth2/CAS

plugins.name: redaxo-api-addon
plugins.description: FriendsOfRedaxo/api addon: bearer-token REST API for articles, categories, slices, modules, templates, languages, media, users

plugins.name: redaxo-search-it
plugins.description: Search It addon: full-text search, indexing articles/media/DB columns/PDFs, search modules, highlighting, autocomplete, similarity search

plugins.name: redaxo-multiglossar
plugins.description: MultiGlossar addon: multilingual glossary terms, frontend term replacement, tooltips/links, article and template exclusions

plugins.name: redaxo-mform
plugins.description: MForm addon: module input forms, flex repeater, custom-link widgets, imagelist, medialist, linklist, color swatch, output helpers
